facts.old: lm-eval: reproducibility standard for base-model benchmarking; backend of the archived Open LLM Leaderboard v1/v2; default for model-card numbers
facts.where: rd-each lm-eval (archive date from the parent's tab; README still calls it the backend).

facts.old: lm-eval architecture: TaskManager, ConfigurableTask from YAML; registry of LM subclasses (hf, vllm, sglang, openai-completions, anthropic, mamba, gguf, 25+ more)
facts.where: rd-each lm-eval; count updated to 37 registered names (aliases included) at d6de816.

facts.old: LM interface: loglikelihood, loglikelihood_rolling, generate_until; batched, cached, distributed
facts.where: rd-score (three methods, four request types) and rd-each.

facts.old: Task YAML: dataset (HF path), doc_to_text/doc_to_target (Jinja or !function), output_type, metrics, filters (regex, majority voting); variants via include:; groups and tags (mmlu = 57 subtasks)
facts.where: rd-each lm-eval; t-same shows the real gsm8k.yaml.

facts.old: loglikelihood vs generate_until is the key split; loglikelihood: P(choice|context) argmax, acc_norm, no sampling, cheap, deterministic, base models, ranking only, API models without logprobs cannot run
facts.where: rd-score part 1. Correction: acc_norm normalises by characters, not bytes (acc_bytes is the byte version).

facts.old: generate_until: completion to stop sequences then filters; needed by chat models; every regex a potential bug; extraction failures score as wrong; 'model X suddenly dropped 20 points'
facts.where: rd-score part 2; rd-mist; t-same extraction bench.

facts.old: Modern reasoning tasks nearly all generative; MCQA migrating from loglikelihood to generative CoT; never compare across formats
facts.where: rd-score part 1 (with Open LLM Leaderboard v2's 4 multiple_choice / 2 generate_until).

facts.old: Gotchas: few-shot formatting and --apply_chat_template change scores; trust_remote_code; filter chains; log the task version hash
facts.where: rd-each lm-eval gotchas; rd-score part 3; rd-repro table.

facts.old: Contributing lm-eval: YAML task ports with parity to reference implementations; fix extraction filters for reasoning models; backends; good first issue and task-request triage
facts.where: rd-contrib lm-eval.

facts.old: Inspect: frontier-safety and agentic standard; used by AISIs, METR, Apollo Research, labs for pre-deployment testing; eval as a program
facts.where: rd-each Inspect; rd-unit.

facts.old: Inspect core: Task = dataset + solver + scorer; solvers transform TaskState (system_message, prompt_template, generate, self_critique, react, basic_agent); scorers exact, match, model_graded_qa, model_graded_fact, custom; metrics; Epochs with reducers for pass@k
facts.where: rd-each Inspect, extended with the current scorer and metric exports and reducer list.

facts.old: Inspect sandboxing: Docker default, k8s and Proxmox adapters; untrusted code, web/CTF/SWE environments, per-sample isolation; nothing in lm-eval compares
facts.where: rd-sandbox, table updated to the nine environments listed on 4 Oct 2026 (correction: more than Docker, k8s, Proxmox).

facts.old: Inspect tooling: inspect view and VS Code extension, full transcripts from .eval logs; best debugging; stable log format
facts.where: rd-each Inspect; t-logs walks a real log.

facts.old: Inspect model support: all major APIs plus vllm and hf; --model switches provider
facts.where: rd-each Inspect (providers list).

facts.old: Inspect contributing: inspect_ai (harder) and inspect_evals (on-ramp); pick a published benchmark, check issues, propose; Q&A before agentic; end-to-end test and parity; untested rejected; docs/methodology.md validation bar
facts.where: rd-contrib correction box: since 8 May 2026 no new eval code (Register), PRs only from pre-approved contributors (2 Oct 2026), agentic now preferred over Q&A; methodology.md and BEST_PRACTICES.md linked.

facts.old: Khalid's judge-battery background: model-graded scorers and judge-reliability tooling are a natural niche
facts.where: rd-contrib, restated for the Register model.

facts.old: HELM: multi-metric (accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, bias, toxicity, efficiency), per-instance dumps, MedHELM and others; maintenance mode 2026-06-01; read for methodology, do not build
facts.where: rd-one table and rd-each HELM box (verified, with policy quotes and last commit 5 Jun 2026).

facts.old: HELM's 'coverage beats headline score' stance predated the field by two years
facts.where: rd-each HELM box.

facts.old: lighteval: 1000+ tasks; transformers/accelerate, vllm, TGI, endpoints, nanotron; hub integration; custom tasks in Python; multilingual; powers HF leaderboards; weaker on parity and agentic; choose for HF stack or in-training-loop evals of nanotron/FSDP
facts.where: rd-each lighteval, plus the new Inspect backend (preferred entry point) and release status.

facts.old: App-level: evaluating the application (prompt + model + RAG + tools), not the model
facts.where: rd-app lead.

facts.old: promptfoo: OSS, CLI/YAML-first, local-first; prompts x providers x test cases; assertions regex to model-graded; diff view; CI; red-teaming/scanner; fastest setup for repo-local regression tests
facts.where: rd-app promptfoo, with assertion counts and the OpenAI acquisition (9 Mar 2026).

facts.old: Braintrust: commercial; Eval() SDK (TS/Python); dataset versioning; autoevals; production trace logging; online scoring; CI gates; human-review queues; offline-to-production loop
facts.where: rd-app Braintrust (checked against its docs).

facts.old: Alternatives: Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave; observability page mention (Topic: agentic-frameworks)
facts.where: rd-app alternatives line with links; Topic: agentic-frameworks linked.

facts.old: Example lm-eval task YAML (my_qa_task with regex filter) and Inspect task (hf_dataset, system_message, generate, model_graded_qa)
facts.where: Replaced by the real files at pinned commits in t-same (GSM8K in each harness); the illustrative snippets were not real tasks.

facts.old: Contrast: harness optimises reproducible standardisation of hundreds of fixed tasks; Inspect optimises expressing arbitrary eval logic as Python with full transcripts
facts.where: rd-unit opening paragraphs and animation.

facts.old: Enclave: DeepMind Aug 2026 double-blind pilot with Singapore AISI, OpenMined, AVERI, MLCommons; Confidential Space; neither side sees the other's secret; only scores out
facts.where: Owned by Topic: benchmarks (as the parent's coverage records); here one line in rd-sandbox and the decision tree, DeepMind blog in t-more.

facts.old: Enclave: non-contamination as a property of where code ran; reusable private benchmark
facts.where: Topic: benchmarks (linked).

facts.old: Enclave cost: no transcripts, so a bad score cannot be attributed between capability gap, broken extraction filter, truncated completion; needs a separate debugging channel
facts.where: rd-sandbox box and rd-repro (the three suspects).

facts.old: Enclave caveats: one small model, evaluated party's own cloud, nothing about crawl leakage
facts.where: Topic: benchmarks (linked).

facts.old: Which to use when table (7 rows: lm-eval, Inspect, lighteval, promptfoo/Braintrust, Braintrust/Langfuse/Phoenix, HELM read-don't-adopt, enclave pilot)
facts.where: rd-choose table (all rows kept, two added: Unitxt, reproducing a published number) plus the interactive decision tree.

facts.old: Boundary rule: model-level = 'is this checkpoint good'; app-level = 'is this system change safe to ship'; Khalid's regression-gate work is the second; harness for swap candidate plus app golden sets (Production eval engineering)
